messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] cinderfold-prod (VPC) - toolcall parser errors spike detected. 95% error rate in last 2m. Severity: Sev2. Pager: @alexr, @marta. Link: https://incidents.redwood.internal/2005123456
Alex R: acked. jumping in now. any customer impact details?
Marta P: CSE just pinged - their end users see 500s from our toolcall proxy. Customer on Dedicated pool in us-east-1. They reported this after our 02:12 runtime patch.
Samir K: looking at logs from the dedicated pool. I see a lot of: `toolcall.ParserError: unexpected token \"functionName\" at position 1` across many connections. seems like a parser incompat with new JSONpath behavior.
Lia O: are we sure this is parser and not input mutation from client side? Tyler (CSE): customer says they didn't change anything. It started immediately after our deploy.
Alex R: grab dump of a failing payload (redacted):
```
{"tool_call": {"name": "pricing.getQuote","args": "{\"sku\": \"ABC-123\", \"qty\": 10}"}}
```
Samir K: aha, the args field is a stringified JSON in their contract. new parser expects structured object by default. older parser accepted stringified args and attempted re-parse. runtime 2026.03.12 switched to strict mode.
Marta P: impact: cinderfold has ~7% of traffic on this pool during peak; we’re returning 500s, customers report loss of functionality for quote tool. Need mitigation ASAP.
Alex R: mitigation options: 1) rollback runtime to last nightly (fast, infra deploy). 2) enable compat-mode on their tenant (config flag we can flip, no restart). 3) route cinderfold to a compat edge instance. Which is fastest?
Samir K: option 2 should be fastest if we have tenant flags for parser-compat. I can push flag to control plane and it will reach the private cluster via config sync within ~3m.
Lia O: Do we have a runbook entry for parser compat? Alex R: yes, runbook section "toolcall-parser-compat" includes the control-plane api call. I'll paste it:
```
POST https://control.redwood.internal/tenants/cinderfold/config
{
  "parser_mode": "legacy-args-accept"
}
```
Samir K: executing now.
deploy-bot: config-sync started for tenant cinderfold -> staging -> prod (sync id: cs-9921).
Samir K: flip done. watching logs.
Marta P: pinging Tyler that we're flipping compat flag. Tyler (CSE): got it, telling customer.
Alex R: metrics: error rate dropping from 95% -> 40% now. Some connections still failing due to warm-up.
Samir K: warm-up in progress, KV caches and parser shards warming. I'll tail logs for the next 10m.
Lia O: is there any risk to other tenants with compat-mode on for cinderfold? Should be tenant-scoped config. Confirmed?
Samir K: yes tenant-scoped. control-plane prevents cross-tenant bleed.
Alex R: ok keep compat-mode while we craft a fix. Root cause: strict parser change shipped without backward-compat shim for stringified args. Priority: rollout shim to runtime image and then roll forward.
Marta P: Customer impact note for incident: Cinderfold quoting service degraded, some users unable to generate quotes for 18 minutes starting at 02:12. Customer success notified and monitoring open.
Samir K: starting build of parser-compat-shim branch. I can build a quick sanitizer that attempts JSON.parse on string args before handing to parser. If tests pass, we can push to dedicated pool as a hotfix image. ETA ~25-30m.
Alex R: good. I'll take incident ownership until handoff. Lia, can you prepare a concise summary for the 08:30 handoff? include timeline, actions, customer impact, current mitigations, and next steps.
Lia O: on it.
Tyler (CSE): Customer replies: thanks for quick action. They need an ETA for full fix vs temporary workaround. I've told them we'll aim to ship compat patch in <1h and keep compat-mode until verified.
Samir K: build complete, running unit + integration fixtures against a sanitized payload matrix. kicking off canary deploy to one node in the dedicated pool.
Marta P: FYI: alert silence requested for this thread by CSE while we verify, but keep paging for regressions.
Alex R: canary looks good for 10 minutes with no new ParserError. Promoting hotfix to pool.
deploy-bot: hotfix roll (parser-compat-shim:v1.0.1) started. progressing: 1/6 -> 3/6 -> 6/6 nodes.
Samir K: rollout complete. I will flip compat-mode off after validation to ensure new runtime works without tenant flag.
Alex R: metrics: error rate now down to baseline ~0.5%. Verified with Cinderfold CSE.
Tyler (CSE): Customer confirms quoting flows are back. They want a postmortem and assurance steps to prevent reoccurrence.
Lia O: created incident doc: https://incidents.redwood.internal/2005123456/postmortem (draft). adding timeline, root cause, mitigation, and follow-ups.
Alex R: follow-ups: 1) add parser-compat unit tests for stringified args (Samir). 2) add pre-deploy gating that runs a tenant-contracted payload matrix (Marta + QA). 3) better deploy notes on parser-mode changes (Eng Docs). 4) CSE communication and SLA check (Tyler).
Samir K: taking item 1. ETA 3 working days.
Marta P: taking item 2 with QA, will propose gating PR by EOD.
Alex R: handing off to Lia for the next shift. Lia, you have incident owner oncall. I’ll be available for questions.
Lia O: acknowledged. I'll update the incident doc and coordinate the follow-up tracker.
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] Incident 2005123456 - cinderfold-prod toolcall parser drift - mitigation applied and hotfix rolled. Severity degraded to Sev4. Duration: 00:48:44.
Alex R: thanks all. leaving notes in the PR for the runtime change that caused this.
Tyler (CSE): customer appreciated the responsiveness. Closing their open ticket after postmortem.
